Strategy: Use an item-scaled band between thirty and forty-five with a near-exact penalty, both scaled to half an item. It may help by combining the good band with sliver avoidance at item scale, but may fail if the penalty shuns exact fits that save bins.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (item / 2 if r - item >= 30 and r - item <= 45 else 0) - (item / 2 if r - item >= 0 and r - item <= 5 else 0) for r in bins]
```
